messages.author: f62a8129ffa477e8
messages.subject: Daily ENMO
parts:
Hello Vincent,

Is it possible to compute ENMO values during waking hours? So far I have obtained L5, M5, and mean ENMO 0-24hr.

Thank you so much,
Carola

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Daily ENMO
parts:
Hi Carola,

Yes, you can in GGIR part 5. See output variable "ACC_day_mg" in the part5 csv reports. This reflects the average of acceleration metric defined with argument acc.metric during waking hours.

Best, Vincent

Dr. Vincent van Hees | Independent consultant | https://accelting.com/
